paite: Nipikal a ani masapen ahong tun in, zingsangpi khomial lai in, han ah Mari Magdalin ava hoh a, hansuang lakkhiaksa in amu hi.
heading: Han Vuak / (Mat 28.1-8; Mar 16.1-8; Luk 24.1-12)
english: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

paite: Huchi in atai a, Simon Peter leh nungzui dang, Jesu'n a-itpa kiang ah ahong pai a, "Han a kipan Toupa apaimangpih ua, akoihna uh ka thei kei uh," chi in agen hi.
english: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”

paite: Huchi in Peter apawt a, nungzui dang toh han lam azuan uhi.
english: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

paite: Atai tuak ua; nungzui dang in Peter amakhelh a, han atung masa hi.
english: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.

paite: Huan kunsuk in a-en a, puanmalngat hoih amu a; himahleh asung ah alut kei hi.
english: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.

paite: Simon Peter amah nung in ahong tung sam a, han sung ah alutsuak a; puanmalngat hoih omte amu hi.
english: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

paite: Jesu lukhung a kinulna puan pen, puanmalngat hoih lak a om lou a, atuam a khepsa a om amu hi.
english: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

paite: Huchi in nungzui dang, han tung masazaw pen leng alut sam a, amu a, agingta hi.
english: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

paite: Misi lak a kipan a thounawn ding ahi, chih Laisiangthou gen atheigige nawn kei uhi.
english: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

paite: Huchi in nungzuite amau inn ah apai nawnta uhi.
english: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

paite: Himahleh han pua ah kap kawm in Mari adingh a; kap kawm in akun a, han sung a-en hi.
heading: Mari Magdalin Kiang Ah Jesu Akilak / (Mat 28.9-10; Mar 16.9-11)
english: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

paite: Huan angel nih puanngou silh, Jesu luang sialna mun ah khat alulam leh khat akhe lam a tu amu hi.
english: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

paite: Huan amau, "Numei, bangziak a kap na hia?" achi uhi. Ama'n, "Ka Toupa apaimangpih ua, akoihna uh ka theih louh ziak in," chi in adawng hi.
english: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”

paite: Huan huchi a agentak in anunglam anga a, Jesu dingh amu a, himahleh Jesu ahi chih athei kei hi.
english: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Numei, bangziak a kap na hia? Kua ahia na zon?" achi hi. Ama'n huanpu hiam asa a, akiang ah, "Pu, amah hiai a kipan a paimangpih na hihleh, na koihna hon hilh tanla, huchi in ka la ding,” achi hi.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Mari" achi hi. Amah akihei a, akiang ah Hebru pau in, "Rabboni" achi a, (huai tuh Sinsakpa chihna ahi).
english: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang ah, "Hon lawng ke'n, tutan in leng Pa kiang ah ka kahtou nai kei hi. Himahleh ka unaute kiang ah va hoh inla, akiang uah, ka pa, na Pa uh, ka Pathian, na Pathian uh kiang ah ka kahtou dek, achi, va chi in," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”

paite: Mari Magdalin ava hoh a, nungzuite kiang ah, "Toupa ka muta," achi a, akiang ah hiai thute agen chih ahilhta hi.
english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

paite: Huan huai ni, nipikal a ni masapen, nitaklam ahong hih in, Judate kihtak ziak a nungzuite omna inn kongkhakte akhak nung un, Jesu ahong pai a, alak uah ahong dingh a, akiang uah, "Na tung uah khamuanna om hen," achi hi.
heading: Nungzuite Kiang A Kilakna / (Mat 28.16-20; Mar 16.14-18; Luk 24.36-49)
english: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

paite: Huai agen khit in akiang uah akhut leh anak alak a, Toupa amuhtak un nungzuite akipak uhi.
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

paite: Jesu'n akiang uah, "Na tung uah khamuanna om hen, Pa'n kei hon sawl bang mah in nou ka hon sawl hi," achi nawn hi.
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

paite: Huai thu agen khit in amau ahatkhum a, akiang uah, "Kha Siangthou tang un.
english: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

paite: Kua khelhna leng na ngaihdam uh ngaihdam ahi ding a; kua khelhna leng na ngaihdam louh uh, ngaihdam louh ahi ding,” achi hi.
english: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

paite: Huan Jesu ahong lai in sawm-le-nihte lak a pang sam Thomas, Didum achih uh, akiang uah a-om kei hi.
heading: Thomas Kiang A Kilakna
english: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

paite: Huchi in nungzui dangte'n akiang ah, "Toupa ka muta uh," achi uhi. Himahleh ama'n akiang uah, "Akhut sikkhetna pawn ka muh a, ka khutzung a ka khoih a, anak a ka khut ka golhlut hial keileh ka gingta kei ding," achi hi.
english: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

paite: Huan ani giat nung in, insung ah anungzuite a-om nawn ua, Thomas leng akiang uah a-om sam hi. Huan kongkhakte khak hinapi in Jesu ahong pai a, alak uah ahong dinghta a, akiang uah, "Na tung uah khamuanna om hen," achi hi.
english: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

paite: Huan Thomas kiang ah, "Na khutzung in sawk in, ka khutte en in; na khut in khoih inla, ka nak ah sawk in; ging lou ke'nla, gingta mai in," achi hi.
english: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

paite: Thomas in, "Ka Toupa leh ka Pathian na hi," chi in adawng hi.
english: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

paite: Jesu'n akiang ah, "Nang zaw na hon muh ziak in na gingta ahi; mu lou a gingta peuhmahte ahampha uh," achi hi.
english: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n nungzuite ma ah chiamtehna dang tamtak ahih a, huaite hiai laibu ah gelh vek ahi kei hi.
heading: Tanchinhoih In Atup
english: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

paite: Himahleh Jesu tuh huai Khrist, Pathian Tapa ahi chih na gintakna ding uleh, na gintak ua amin a hinna na neihna ding ua gelh ahi.
english: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
